summary: 16 of 24 pass. The 8 failures fall into three groups. (1) Evidence that is not on the entry page. The two plugin links quote real lines from the bundle scroll, but the entry pages say nothing about the VST Template. Deposit->CHILD quotes a line that lives on CLAUDE.md, not CHILD. (2) Rule citations dressed as tracts. Palace Conatus->Reference and Revival->Reference cite a rule that every page of their kind cites, and Reference never names them. To-Do->CAD Drafter rests on a checkbox that goes stale the day it is ticked. (3) Origin or type misread. Spinoza Conatus came from the Deleuzian dialogue, not 'the Spinoza dialogue', and from a run of the mode rather than the mode's page. The kept Lateral Access enables has no reason on either body, and the only stated relation (a mirror) is on a third page. The weaker pattern behind all three: the readers were reaching to give inbound links to under-reached newcomers. CHILD is offered 8 new links and SCHEMA — Reference 8. The ones that pass are those where the target names the source back (Reference:310 to CHILD, :341 to The Scroll, :159-166 to Substrate Skill, :115/:344-345 to Making a Palace Citizen). Two passes (Project Stewardship->VST Template, Pheromone Trail->Reference) are one-sided enough that a sentence on the target is owed.
